science_axis: Independent documented multi-field theoretical and experimental NMR source context; non-FN1 ubiquitin, no regression fitted here

article.title: An Approach to Direct Determination of Protein Dynamics from 15N NMR Relaxation at Multiple Fields, Independent of Variable 15N Chemical Shift Anisotropy and Chemical Exchange Contributions
article.claim: The original article uses actual multiple-field 15N relaxation of ubiquitin to separate residue-specific spectral density, CSA and chemical exchange under axially symmetric diffusion models

archived_primary_supplement.text_extraction: Scanned pages, zero directly selectable text in pymupdf

inspected_page_map.1-3: Supplementary Table 1: derived spectral density values J(0), J(0.87 omega_H), J(omega_N), J(omega_H), goodness-of-fit etc across ubiquitin residues
inspected_page_map.4-6: Supplementary Table 2: model-free parameters and residue-specific 15N CSA, Method A
inspected_page_map.7-9: Supplementary Table 3: model-free parameters, residue-specific 15N CSA and Rex, Method B
inspected_page_map.10-12: Independent comparison and visual diagnostic graphs; including anisotropic vs isotropic model results

archived_primary_supplement.source_scope: Analysis tables and derived model outputs; full original field-by-field raw R1/R2/NOE experimental triples with uncertainties were NOT recovered from this SI, and must not be fabricated or inferred from already estimated parameters.
archived_primary_supplement.copyright_policy: PDF not redistributed in JANUS GitHub. Link publisher file; record source SHA only.

comparison_context.prior_independent_nmr_relax_formula_chec: three theoretical synthetic proton frequencies 400,600,800 MHz match published relax source but this is NOT empirical multiband prediction

next_gate.goal: Build genuine predictive out-of-field validation, preserving independent measurement uncertainty.
requirements: Recover raw or author-provided per-field 360,500,600 MHz 15N R1,R2,heteronuclear NOE with exact residue IDs and uncertainties
Only then preregister a held-out experimental field, fit parameters on two fields and test on third without retuning
Determine original sample temperature, solvent, references, CSA tensor, NH bond vector and diffusion anisotropy assumptions; restrict cross-study transfer
Do not treat published fitted CSA/rex/derived J as independent ground truth for validating a model fitted to the same data
next_gate.if_missing: STATUS=MULTIFIELD_RAW_NOT_AVAILABLE; retain source but never create synthetic measured values
